description:
UnitySVC runs the official ntfy server in a separate container for each enrollment, with its own HTTPS address. Publish notifications over HTTP and receive them in the ntfy apps or a streaming client. Priorities, tags, click actions, scheduled delivery and attachments are supported. By default, messages are limited to 4096 bytes and kept for 12 hours; exposed `NTFY_*` parameters let you adjust server settings. Storage is temporary: stopping or replacing the instance loses cached messages.

Enroll in the base channel and keep or replace the NTFY_ACCESS_TOKEN parameter. Publish to `https://<instance>/<topic>` with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, or configure the ntfy app with the instance URL and token to subscribe. Set NTFY_BASE_URL to your instance URL for features that need it, including attachments and web push. See How to use this service for full setup and limitations.

You pay the selected channel's platform compute cost while the instance runs, including idle time. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. See the upstream ntfy documentation and issue tracker for software-specific help.

features: A private instance for each enrollment, protected by your access token

name: ntfy-sh

payout_price.description: At cost: UnitySVC Labs receives no seller payout

summary: Push notifications over plain HTTP: POST a message from any script, CI pipeline, or app and receive it on your phone, desktop, or a streaming client, on your own private ntfy instance.

base.description: One private ntfy instance for one enrollment; temporary storage.

NTFY_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Generated for this enrollment; keep it or enter your own (the form tk_ followed by 29 letters, digits, - or _). It is the Bearer token for publishing to and subscribing from your instance, and without it every request is denied. Save it; it is also shown in the enrollment's instance details. Changing it later restarts the instance.
NTFY_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: Access token

NTFY_ATTACHMENT_CACHE_DIR.description: Cache directory for attached files, or S3 URL for object storage (format: s3://KEY:SECRET@BUCKET[/PREFIX]?region=REGION[&endpoint=ENDPOINT][&disable_http2=true]). (NTFY option attachment-cache-dir; format: directory or S3 URL).
NTFY_ATTACHMENT_CACHE_DIR.title: attachment-cache-dir

NTFY_ATTACHMENT_EXPIRY_DURATION.description: Duration after which uploaded attachments will be deleted (e.g. 3h, 20h). Capped at cache-duration. Strongly affects visitor-attachment-total-size-limit. (NTFY option attachment-expiry-duration; format: duration).
NTFY_ATTACHMENT_EXPIRY_DURATION.title: attachment-expiry-duration

NTFY_ATTACHMENT_FILE_SIZE_LIMIT.description: Per-file attachment size limit (e.g. 300k, 2M, 100M). Larger attachment will be rejected. (NTFY option attachment-file-size-limit; format: size).
NTFY_ATTACHMENT_FILE_SIZE_LIMIT.title: attachment-file-size-limit

NTFY_ATTACHMENT_TOTAL_SIZE_LIMIT.description: Limit of the on-disk attachment cache directory. If the limits is exceeded, new attachments will be rejected. (NTFY option attachment-total-size-limit; format: size).
NTFY_ATTACHMENT_TOTAL_SIZE_LIMIT.title: attachment-total-size-limit

NTFY_AUTH_ACCESS_CACHE.description: Enables an in-memory ACL cache so authorization checks no longer hit the database. Only worth enabling on high-volume servers. (NTFY option auth-access-cache; format: bool).
NTFY_AUTH_ACCESS_CACHE.title: auth-access-cache

NTFY_BAN_FILE.description: Abuse ban-feed: file confirmed abusive visitor IPs are appended to, for fail2ban to tail. Empty disables the feature. See Banning bad actors (NTFY option ban-file; format: filename).
NTFY_BAN_FILE.title: ban-file

NTFY_BAN_THRESHOLD.description: Abuse ban-feed: weighted strikes per ban-window before a prefix is written to ban-file (NTFY option ban-threshold; format: number).
NTFY_BAN_THRESHOLD.title: ban-threshold

NTFY_BAN_WEIGHTS.description: Abuse ban-feed: per-code strike weights (exact code, family 429, or ; longest match wins; 0 exempts). See Banning bad actors (NTFY option ban-weights; format: list of KEY:WEIGHT).
NTFY_BAN_WEIGHTS.title: ban-weights

NTFY_BAN_WINDOW.description: Abuse ban-feed: rolling window over which weighted strikes are counted, per IP prefix (NTFY option ban-window; format: duration).
NTFY_BAN_WINDOW.title: ban-window

NTFY_BASE_URL.description: Public facing base URL of the service (e.g. https://ntfy.sh) (NTFY option base-url; format: URL).
NTFY_BASE_URL.title: base-url

NTFY_BILLING_CONTACT.description: Payments: Email or website displayed in Upgrade dialog as a billing contact (NTFY option billing-contact; format: email address or website).
NTFY_BILLING_CONTACT.title: billing-contact

NTFY_CACHE_BATCH_SIZE.description: Max size of messages to batch together when writing to message cache (if zero, writes are synchronous) (NTFY option cache-batch-size; format: int).
NTFY_CACHE_BATCH_SIZE.title: cache-batch-size

NTFY_CACHE_BATCH_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout for batched async writes to the message cache (if zero, writes are synchronous) (NTFY option cache-batch-timeout; format: duration).
NTFY_CACHE_BATCH_TIMEOUT.title: cache-batch-timeout

NTFY_CACHE_DURATION.description: Duration for which messages will be buffered before they are deleted. This is required to support the since=... and poll=1 parameter. Set this to 0 to disable the cache entirely. (NTFY option cache-duration; format: duration).
NTFY_CACHE_DURATION.title: cache-duration

NTFY_CACHE_STARTUP_QUERIES.description: SQL queries to run during database startup; this is useful for tuning and enabling WAL mode (NTFY option cache-startup-queries; format: string (SQL queries)).
NTFY_CACHE_STARTUP_QUERIES.title: cache-startup-queries

NTFY_ENABLE_LOGIN.description: Allows users to log in via the web app, or API (NTFY option enable-login; format: boolean (true or false)).
NTFY_ENABLE_LOGIN.title: enable-login

NTFY_ENABLE_RESERVATIONS.description: Allows users to reserve topics (if their tier allows it) (NTFY option enable-reservations; format: boolean (true or false)).
NTFY_ENABLE_RESERVATIONS.title: enable-reservations

NTFY_ENABLE_SIGNUP.description: Allows users to sign up via the web app, or API (NTFY option enable-signup; format: boolean (true or false)).
NTFY_ENABLE_SIGNUP.title: enable-signup

NTFY_GLOBAL_TOPIC_LIMIT.description: Rate limiting: Total number of topics before the server rejects new topics. (NTFY option global-topic-limit; format: number).
NTFY_GLOBAL_TOPIC_LIMIT.title: global-topic-limit

NTFY_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL.description: Interval in which keepalive messages are sent to the client. This is to prevent intermediaries closing the connection for inactivity. Note that the Android app has a hardcoded timeout at 77s, so it should be less than that. (NTFY option keepalive-interval; format: duration).
NTFY_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL.title: keepalive-interval

NTFY_LOG_FILE.description: Defines the filename to write logs to. If this is not set, ntfy logs to stderr (NTFY option log-file; format: string).
NTFY_LOG_FILE.title: log-file

NTFY_LOG_FORMAT.description: Defines the output format, can be text or json (NTFY option log-format; format: string).
NTFY_LOG_FORMAT.title: log-format

NTFY_LOG_LEVEL.description: Defines the default log level, can be one of trace, debug, info, warn or error (NTFY option log-level; format: string).
NTFY_LOG_LEVEL.title: log-level

NTFY_MANAGER_INTERVAL.description: Interval in which the manager prunes old messages, deletes topics and prints the stats. (NTFY option manager-interval; format: duration).
NTFY_MANAGER_INTERVAL.title: manager-interval

NTFY_MESSAGE_DELAY_LIMIT.description: Amount of time a message can be scheduled into the future when using the Delay header (NTFY option message-delay-limit; format: duration).
NTFY_MESSAGE_DELAY_LIMIT.title: message-delay-limit

NTFY_MESSAGE_SIZE_LIMIT.description: The size limit for the message body. Please note that this is largely untested, and that FCM/APNS have limits around 4KB. If you increase this size limit, FCM and APNS will NOT work for large messages. (NTFY option message-size-limit; format: size).
NTFY_MESSAGE_SIZE_LIMIT.title: message-size-limit

NTFY_PROXY_FORWARDED_HEADER.description: Use specified header to determine visitor IP address (for rate limiting) (NTFY option proxy-forwarded-header; format: string).
NTFY_PROXY_FORWARDED_HEADER.title: proxy-forwarded-header

NTFY_PROXY_TRUSTED_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated list of trusted IP addresses, hosts, or CIDRs to remove from forwarded header (NTFY option proxy-trusted-hosts; format: comma-separated host/IP/CIDR list).
NTFY_PROXY_TRUSTED_HOSTS.title: proxy-trusted-hosts

NTFY_REQUIRE_LOGIN.description: All actions via the web app require a login (NTFY option require-login; format: boolean (true or false)).
NTFY_REQUIRE_LOGIN.title: require-login

NTFY_SMTP_SENDER_ADDR.description: SMTP server address to allow email sending (NTFY option smtp-sender-addr; format: host:port).
NTFY_SMTP_SENDER_ADDR.title: smtp-sender-addr

NTFY_SMTP_SENDER_FROM.description: SMTP sender e-mail address; only used if e-mail sending is enabled (NTFY option smtp-sender-from; format: e-mail address).
NTFY_SMTP_SENDER_FROM.title: smtp-sender-from

NTFY_SMTP_SENDER_PASS.description: SMTP password; only used if e-mail sending is enabled (NTFY option smtp-sender-pass; format: string).
NTFY_SMTP_SENDER_PASS.title: smtp-sender-pass

NTFY_SMTP_SENDER_USER.description: SMTP user; only used if e-mail sending is enabled (NTFY option smtp-sender-user; format: string).
NTFY_SMTP_SENDER_USER.title: smtp-sender-user

NTFY_SMTP_SENDER_VERIFY.description: If true, require verified email addresses for email notifications; anonymous email sending is disabled (NTFY option smtp-sender-verify; format: bool).
NTFY_SMTP_SENDER_VERIFY.title: smtp-sender-verify

NTFY_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.description: Payments: Key used for the Stripe API communication, this enables payments (NTFY option stripe-secret-key; format: string).
NTFY_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.title: stripe-secret-key

NTFY_STRIPE_WEBHOOK_KEY.description: Payments: Key required to validate the authenticity of incoming webhooks from Stripe (NTFY option stripe-webhook-key; format: string).
NTFY_STRIPE_WEBHOOK_KEY.title: stripe-webhook-key

NTFY_TWILIO_ACCOUNT.description: Twilio account SID, e.g. AC... (NTFY option twilio-account; format: string).
NTFY_TWILIO_ACCOUNT.title: twilio-account

NTFY_TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Twilio auth token, e.g. ... (NTFY option twilio-auth-token; format: string).
NTFY_TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN.title: twilio-auth-token

NTFY_TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER.description: Twilio outgoing phone number, e.g. +18775132586 (NTFY option twilio-phone-number; format: string).
NTFY_TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER.title: twilio-phone-number

NTFY_TWILIO_VERIFY_SERVICE.description: Twilio Verify service SID, e.g. VA... (NTFY option twilio-verify-service; format: string).
NTFY_TWILIO_VERIFY_SERVICE.title: twilio-verify-service

NTFY_UPSTREAM_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Access token to use for the upstream server; needed only if upstream rate limits are exceeded or upstream server requires auth (NTFY option upstream-access-token; format: string).
NTFY_UPSTREAM_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: upstream-access-token

NTFY_UPSTREAM_BASE_URL.description: Forward poll request to an upstream server, this is needed for iOS push notifications for self-hosted servers (NTFY option upstream-base-url; format: URL).
NTFY_UPSTREAM_BASE_URL.title: upstream-base-url

NTFY_VISITOR_ATTACHMENT_DAILY_BANDWIDTH_.description: Rate limiting: Total daily traffic limit per visitor, covering attachment downloads/uploads and messages replayed from the cache by poll requests. This is to protect your bandwidth costs from exploding. (NTFY option visitor-attachment-daily-bandwidth-limit; format: size).
NTFY_VISITOR_ATTACHMENT_DAILY_BANDWIDTH_.title: visitor-attachment-daily-bandwidth-limit

NTFY_VISITOR_ATTACHMENT_TOTAL_SIZE_LIMIT.description: Rate limiting: Total storage limit used for attachments per visitor, for all attachments combined. Storage is freed after attachments expire. See attachment-expiry-duration. (NTFY option visitor-attachment-total-size-limit; format: size).
NTFY_VISITOR_ATTACHMENT_TOTAL_SIZE_LIMIT.title: visitor-attachment-total-size-limit

NTFY_VISITOR_EMAIL_LIMIT_BURST.description: Rate limiting:Initial limit of e-mails per visitor (NTFY option visitor-email-limit-burst; format: number).
NTFY_VISITOR_EMAIL_LIMIT_BURST.title: visitor-email-limit-burst

NTFY_VISITOR_EMAIL_LIMIT_REPLENISH.description: Rate limiting: Strongly related to visitor-email-limit-burst: The rate at which the bucket is refilled (NTFY option visitor-email-limit-replenish; format: duration).
NTFY_VISITOR_EMAIL_LIMIT_REPLENISH.title: visitor-email-limit-replenish

NTFY_VISITOR_MESSAGE_DAILY_LIMIT.description: Rate limiting: Allowed number of messages per day per visitor, reset every 24 hours at the visitor's own time of day. By default, this value is unset. (NTFY option visitor-message-daily-limit; format: number).
NTFY_VISITOR_MESSAGE_DAILY_LIMIT.title: visitor-message-daily-limit

NTFY_VISITOR_PREFIX_BITS_IPV4.description: Rate limiting: Number of bits to use for IPv4 visitor prefix, e.g. 24 for /24 (NTFY option visitor-prefix-bits-ipv4; format: number).
NTFY_VISITOR_PREFIX_BITS_IPV4.title: visitor-prefix-bits-ipv4

NTFY_VISITOR_PREFIX_BITS_IPV6.description: Rate limiting: Number of bits to use for IPv6 visitor prefix, e.g. 48 for /48 (NTFY option visitor-prefix-bits-ipv6; format: number).
NTFY_VISITOR_PREFIX_BITS_IPV6.title: visitor-prefix-bits-ipv6

NTFY_VISITOR_REQUEST_LIMIT_BURST.description: Rate limiting: Allowed GET/PUT/POST requests per second, per visitor. This setting is the initial bucket of requests each visitor has (NTFY option visitor-request-limit-burst; format: number).
NTFY_VISITOR_REQUEST_LIMIT_BURST.title: visitor-request-limit-burst

NTFY_VISITOR_REQUEST_LIMIT_EXEMPT_HOSTS.description: Rate limiting: List of hostnames and IPs to be exempt from request rate limiting (NTFY option visitor-request-limit-exempt-hosts; format: comma-separated host/IP/CIDR list).
NTFY_VISITOR_REQUEST_LIMIT_EXEMPT_HOSTS.title: visitor-request-limit-exempt-hosts

NTFY_VISITOR_REQUEST_LIMIT_REPLENISH.description: Rate limiting: Strongly related to visitor-request-limit-burst: The rate at which the bucket is refilled (NTFY option visitor-request-limit-replenish; format: duration).
NTFY_VISITOR_REQUEST_LIMIT_REPLENISH.title: visitor-request-limit-replenish

NTFY_VISITOR_SUBSCRIBER_RATE_LIMITING.description: Rate limiting: Enables subscriber-based rate limiting (NTFY option visitor-subscriber-rate-limiting; format: bool).
NTFY_VISITOR_SUBSCRIBER_RATE_LIMITING.title: visitor-subscriber-rate-limiting

NTFY_VISITOR_SUBSCRIPTION_LIMIT.description: Rate limiting: Number of subscriptions per visitor (IP address) (NTFY option visitor-subscription-limit; format: number).
NTFY_VISITOR_SUBSCRIPTION_LIMIT.title: visitor-subscription-limit

NTFY_VISITOR_TOPIC_CREATION_LIMIT_BURST.description: Rate limiting: Initial bucket of new topic creations per visitor. 0 disables the limit. (NTFY option visitor-topic-creation-limit-burst; format: number).
NTFY_VISITOR_TOPIC_CREATION_LIMIT_BURST.title: visitor-topic-creation-limit-burst

NTFY_VISITOR_TOPIC_CREATION_LIMIT_REPLEN.description: Rate limiting: Rate at which the per-visitor topic-creation bucket is refilled (one new topic per x). (NTFY option visitor-topic-creation-limit-replenish; format: duration).
NTFY_VISITOR_TOPIC_CREATION_LIMIT_REPLEN.title: visitor-topic-creation-limit-replenish

NTFY_WEB_PUSH_EMAIL_ADDRESS.description: Web Push: Sender email address (NTFY option web-push-email-address; format: string).
NTFY_WEB_PUSH_EMAIL_ADDRESS.title: web-push-email-address

NTFY_WEB_PUSH_EXPIRY_DURATION.description: Web Push: Duration after which a subscription is considered stale and will be deleted. This is to prevent stale subscriptions. (NTFY option web-push-expiry-duration; format: duration).
NTFY_WEB_PUSH_EXPIRY_DURATION.title: web-push-expiry-duration

NTFY_WEB_PUSH_EXPIRY_WARNING_DURATION.description: Web Push: Duration after which a warning is sent to subscribers that their subscription will expire soon. This is to prevent stale subscriptions. (NTFY option web-push-expiry-warning-duration; format: duration).
NTFY_WEB_PUSH_EXPIRY_WARNING_DURATION.title: web-push-expiry-warning-duration

NTFY_WEB_PUSH_FILE.description: Web Push: Database file that stores subscriptions (NTFY option web-push-file; format: string).
NTFY_WEB_PUSH_FILE.title: web-push-file

NTFY_WEB_PUSH_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Web Push: Private Key. Run ntfy webpush keys to generate (NTFY option web-push-private-key; format: string).
NTFY_WEB_PUSH_PRIVATE_KEY.title: web-push-private-key

NTFY_WEB_PUSH_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Web Push: Public Key. Run ntfy webpush keys to generate (NTFY option web-push-public-key; format: string).
NTFY_WEB_PUSH_PUBLIC_KEY.title: web-push-public-key

NTFY_WEB_PUSH_STARTUP_QUERIES.description: Web Push: SQL queries to run against subscription database at startup (NTFY option web-push-startup-queries; format: string).
NTFY_WEB_PUSH_STARTUP_QUERIES.title: web-push-startup-queries

NTFY_WEB_ROOT.description: Sets root of the web app (e.g. /, or /app), or disables it entirely (disable) (NTFY option web-root; format: path, e.g. / or /app, or disable).
NTFY_WEB_ROOT.title: web-root
